about: Does public GitHub history show a change since the gsm / OpenRBQM team adopted AI coding agents? Counted for the R/Pharma 2026 keynote. Draft; aggregate only, no account names.
cut_off: Nothing on or after 2026-10-07T00:00:00Z is counted. Quarters are calendar quarters in UTC; 2026 Q3 (July to September) is the last whole one.

definitions.issues_opened: issues (not pull requests) by created date
definitions.issues_closed: issues by closed date, whatever the reason
definitions.releases: published GitHub releases whose tag looks like a version (v1.2.3), by published date, whoever published them
definitions.bot: the account that opened the item is of type Bot (dependabot, github-actions, cm-operations-bot, ci-gh-app). "no_bots" leaves these out; "with_bots" keeps them.
definitions.coding_agent_account: a Bot account belonging to a coding agent (Copilot coding agent, Claude, Codex, Devin, Jules, Cursor). Counted separately from other bots.
definitions.agent_written_commit: an AI-marked commit that is not a Copilot suggestion accepted in the browser (GitHub as committer and a subject GitHub writes: "Update <file>", "Apply suggestions from code review", "Potential fix for ...")
definitions.ai_marked_commit: a non-merge commit whose message has a Co-authored-by trailer naming Claude or Copilot (or another AI tool), or whose author is one. Commits are read from every branch, tag and pull request head and counted once per hash; commits by workflow and dependency bots are left out of both the count and the base.
definitions.attribution_line: the body has "drafted by" followed within 40 characters by the name of an AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Posit Assistant, Codex, GPT, Cursor, Gemini, assistant, agent). The team convention is "This PR was drafted by <agent> using <model> and reviewed by <person>".
definitions.ai_written_pr: a pull request with an attribution line or tool footer in its body, or at least one agent-written commit, or opened by a coding-agent account. A pull request whose only mark is an accepted Copilot suggestion or a Copilot review is not counted here; it is counted in ai_any_incl_review.
definitions.copilot_review: a review on the pull request submitted by a Copilot bot account
definitions.test_file: tests/testthat/test-*.R, or *.test.js / *.spec.js / a .js file under tests/ or __tests__/. A merged pull request touches a test when one of its commits (as GitHub lists them) adds or changes such a file.

all_25.label: All 25 public repositories
all_25.rule: Every public repository of the ecosystem (the earlier pass's list).

active_both_years.label: Worked on in both years
active_both_years.rule: At least 5 pull requests merged (bots left out) between 1 January and 6 October in 2025 and again in 2026.

without_new_in_2026.label: Without repositories new in 2026
without_new_in_2026.rule: Leaves out repositories with no issue, pull request or release before 1 January 2026.

active_in_2026.label: Worked on in 2026 (chosen on the outcome; flatters 2026)
active_in_2026.rule: At least 5 pull requests merged in the 2026 window, whatever happened in 2025.

active_in_2025.label: Worked on in 2025 (chosen on the baseline; flatters 2025)
active_in_2025.rule: At least 5 pull requests merged in the 2025 window, whatever happened in 2026.

pipeline_six.label: The six pipeline packages
pipeline_six.rule: gsm, gsm.core, gsm.mapping, gsm.kri, gsm.reporting, gsm.qtl (the earlier pass's cut).

search_api_quarterly.how: GitHub search API total_count, no login, one query per measure, quarter and variant; every query is in crosscheck.json

search_api_ai_marks.note: The search matches the bare phrase "drafted by" and includes items opened by bots, so it can exceed the fetch count, which needs an AI tool named after the phrase and leaves bots out.

git_grep_ai_trailers.command: git log --all --no-merges -i -E --grep='^[[:space:]]*co-authored-by:.*(claude|copilot|anthropic)' --format='%H %aI', per clone, unique hashes, author date 2025-01-01 to 2026-10-06
